text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of tryouts arrives, and there's
excitement in the air as trainers
gather in
hopes of scouting the latest and greatest
in talented
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho! A familiar face! It's nice to see you
again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ready? I was BORN ready! No one's raring
to go like me, the class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my race is up next, so I must be
off! Just TRY to keep up
with my
astonishing speed! But beware... you might
just be blinded by
my EXCELLENCE!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin! Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That was Sakura Bakushin O, right? Did
she just say she's in the next
race? My data
says she specializes in sprints...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
But next up is the long-distance race...
What is she planning?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With furrowed brows, the other curious
trainers and I look on as
Sakura Bakushin
O's race begins...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Bakushin, Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O bursts out of the gates
and takes the lead! She's
pulling away
from the rest of the runners!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There's more where that came from!
Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Look at her go! With that speed, she might
be the fastest
Umamusume on the track
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Raaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race has only just begun, and the
crowd is going wild! An unusual
reaction to
say the least, but after seeing Sakura
Bakushin O, I
completely understand.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is she thinking?! She can't use
that much power right out of
the gate!
But... then again...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What amazing speed! I've never seen
someone start a race off like
this!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: If she can keep it up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a brief moment, even the veteran
trainers have their eyes glued to
the track,
the prospect of a new racing superstar
filling them with
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners are rounding the fourth turn!
Their actions from this point
on will decide
the outcome of the race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin... Bakushiiin...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
S-Sakura Bakushin O is losing speed! Has
her initial energy run dry?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Can't... keep... going... Must... slow... down.

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Sakura Bakushin O loses speed, the
other Umamusume pick up
their pace,
eventually leaving her in twelfth place...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Twelfth place?! TWELFTH! What a
disgrace...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No... Luck had nothing to do with it. The
others really gave their all,
and it showed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nothing screams maturity like
acknowledging your opponents'
strength!
As expected of the dignified class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she is. Sakura Bakushin O! I'd
like to have a word with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Would those words happen to be "I'm here
to scout you"?! I was
wondering when
you'd show up!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
W-well, that certainly saves me some time.
You may not have won
today, but your
speed really impressed me. I'd love to take
you under
my wing.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I know you've got what it takes to
dominate every short-distance race
out
there! Together, we'll make you the best
sprinter in the world!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's right! I'll be the best—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sprinter?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Is there a problem? Judging
from that race, you're
clearly suited to
shorter distances...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... Shorter distances, yes...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Apologies, but I must decline! Thank you
for your interest in the
trainer position!
Now... go back from whence you came!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! B-but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taken aback by her vehement dismissal,
the trainer stands there for a
moment,
before eventually shuffling away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What a disappointment, but oh well! When one door closes, another is sure to open!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now then... What about you? You've seen what I can do, so surely you have something you'd like to say!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Or... Are you going to try to recruit me as
a sprinter too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you have to think about it, then we both
know the answer! As much
as I hate to do
this, it's going to be a no from me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I refuse to be limited to just
sprints! NO WAY, NO
HOW!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Because I am class representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now I have a question for YOU! Can you
name all the G1 races that
AREN'T
sprints? Go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: STOP! Starting to get the picture?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There's loads and LOADS of races out
there! And I want to win all of
them, not
just the short-distance ones!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Remember what I said the other day? I
exist to be class
representative, and the
class representative role exists for me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a model for ALL students to
look up to!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And what type of runner do you think of
when you hear that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A sprinter? A miler? A stayer? No, you
don't think of just one. You
think of a
runner who can do it all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And THAT is the kind of runner the class
representative should be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So if you'll excuse me, I have places to go,
people to see! Bakushin!
Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can manage to fumble together a
response, Sakura Bakushin
O is long
gone...
